title: Claude — data collection for the 20 partial programme audits published on PropRadar (no stars)
author: Claude (Opus 5.5)
scope: Objective data only, ahead of the per-category product scale: commercial availability, structure, drawdown mechanics, withdrawal conditions and restrictions. No stars are computed. The general 100-point score, prices and production are untouched.
method: Sources in this order: official pages read or searched on 28 Nov 2026; the agent/terms-archive branch (full-text captures of 25 Nov 2026); PropRadar firm-updates.json restrictive rules; competitor comparators where official text is missing (marked type "competitor"). Each fact keeps its source type; competitor-only facts are flagged in fundedApplies or contradictions.
availabilityValues: available (listed, not in the comparison table)

programmes.programme: High Stakes (2-Step, New 10%/5% and Classic 8%/5%) — Pro account

availability.evidence: High Stakes page read 28 Nov 2026 (New tab live); general rules FAQ updated 3 Nov 2026; drawdown FAQ updated 16 Nov 2026.

drawdown.daily: 3%-5% depending on plan (5% on the main tiers); recalculated at 00:00 server time from the higher of previous-day closing balance or closing equity; breach = termination.
drawdown.max: 8%-10% depending on plan (10% on New); "absolute drawdown from your initial account balance"; breach = termination.
drawdown.fundedApplies: stated: same loss limits on the Pro account
drawdown.notes: Older July education pages called the drawdown trailing; the 16 Nov 2026 High Stakes drawdown FAQ states absolute from initial balance.

payout.first: 14 days after Pro account start
payout.cap: $3,000 per payout (50K) / $4,000 (100K); crypto withdrawals limited to $1,500 per transaction; T&C 7.6 allows an unpublished per-transaction threshold above which payouts are split into consecutive weekly instalments.
payout.consistency: No consistency rule on the High Stakes page, general rules FAQ (3 Nov) or payout FAQ (24 Nov). The 50% funded best-day rule found in the 2-Step Plan FAQ belongs to the separate "Summer" 2-Step plan (PropFirmMatch and The GodFunded list it under Summer plans; FundedFast and CryptoSlate list High Stakes with no consistency rule). One official blog (Sep 2026) still says 50% for High Stakes.
payout.other: Three profitable days of at least 0.5% of initial balance are required for each scale-up; interview may be requested and must take place within 5 business days or pending payouts are denied (T&C 3.2).

restrictions.news: Executing orders from 2 minutes before to 2 minutes after high-impact news is prohibited (Forex Factory, server time); profits from that window are deducted, losses kept. Holding through news allowed.
restrictions.automation: Own EAs allowed; third-party EAs where other traders hold the same trades, EAs without owned source code, and EAs creating excessive server load are prohibited.
restrictions.copyTrading: Trade coordination or copy trading with other traders/accounts prohibited.
restrictions.holdTime: No numeric minimum; HFT "measured within a few seconds" and tick scalping prohibited.
restrictions.riskLimits: No per-trade risk cap or stop-loss requirement on High Stakes.
restrictions.inactivity: 60 consecutive days on Pro accounts (30 on evaluation).
restrictions.other: Discretionary "uncommercial activity" clause (Trading Rule 19); termination allowed for public disparaging statements (T&C 10.1); VPN geo-circumvention is a fundamental breach.

contradictions: Consistency: one official blog (Sep 2026) states a 50% funded rule for High Stakes; all current High Stakes rule pages state none and third parties attribute the 50% rule to the Summer plan.
openQuestions: Ask The5ers to confirm in writing that High Stakes Pro has no best-day rule.

availability.evidence: Programme page archived 25 Nov 2026 shows Swing $2K-$40K plans with live checkout links; competitor tables (July-Oct 2026) list Swing MAX.

drawdown.daily: 3% daily pause: when equity minus start-of-day realised balance exceeds the limit, positions are closed and trading pauses until the next day (not a breach); one optional pause reset per day.
drawdown.max: 7% of buying power (e.g. $700 on $10K). Stop-out is measured on equity ("projected balance"). Once equity reaches 3x the daily limit (+9%), the floor moves once, instantly, to the initial balance.
drawdown.type: static floor with a one-time step-up to the initial balance at +3x DL (equity-based)
drawdown.fundedApplies: partly stated: the 7% figure is published for the evaluation; the programme page says funded traders "keep trading under the same trading conditions (DL, Exposure)"; the 3x DL move is in the payouts section; Program Terms say swing scaling mechanics are "to come".

payout.split: 70/30 in the published plan table (competitors: up to 80% once funded)
payout.first: 14 days
payout.frequency: every 14 days; a scale-up restarts the withdrawal clock
payout.minimum: $300 profit ($150 on smallest size), at least 5 positions
payout.cap: none published
payout.consistency: Maximum position profit ratio: 30% in evaluation, 70% in funded (position-based, not best-day).
payout.other: Scaling at +10% validated profit on buying power.

restrictions.news: No news restriction published.
restrictions.overnightWeekend: Overnight and weekend holding allowed with full exposure; opening a position to hold overnight requires the stock to average at least 500,000 shares/day over the previous 14 days; tickers are disabled before earnings (no earnings holding).
restrictions.automation: Not restricted for swing in the published terms (automated trading notes concern FLEX day).
restrictions.copyTrading: Allowed only between 2 own accounts; for swing only $2K and $10K accounts may be paired; wash trading (opposite position within 30 minutes in another account) forbidden.
restrictions.holdTime: Minimum 30 seconds and $0.10 entry-to-exit movement for a trade to count.
restrictions.riskLimits: Buying-power limits only; total base buying power across accounts capped at $450K.
restrictions.inactivity: 14-day inactivity timeout on funded accounts (baseline evidence).
restrictions.other: Minimum 5 positions for a payout or scale-up; regular-hours volume rules per asset.

openQuestions: Confirm in writing that the 7% maximum loss and the 3x-DL move apply unchanged on funded swing accounts.

programmes.programme: Instant funding (95% split) — legacy catalogue ID

availability.evidence: The 25 Nov 2026 Terms list five instant plans, all at 100% split: Instant Lite, Classic, Pro, Prime and Plus. "Up to 95%" survives only on the instant.ofpfunding.com marketing page. No plan with a 95% split is in the current Terms.

currentEquivalents.Instant Lite: $50K-$200K; 3% daily / 5% overall; 1% max risk; 5% profit target; min 5 days; max 30 days; no consistency.
currentEquivalents.Instant Classic: $5K-$200K; 5% / 10%; 1% max risk; no target; min 5 days; 25% consistency.
currentEquivalents.Instant Pro: $25K-$100K; 3% / 5%; 1% max risk; min 10 days; no consistency; monthly payout.
currentEquivalents.Instant Prime: $10K-$200K; 5% / 10%; 1% max risk; min 10 days; no consistency.
currentEquivalents.Instant Plus: $5K-$100K; 3% / 6%; no max-risk rule; min 5 days; no consistency.

drawdown.daily: Balance must not fall below the highest balance of the calendar day minus the daily %, UK time (T&C 6.2.2).
drawdown.max: Balance must not lose more than the overall % of the balance at the last Reward (T&C 6.2.3): fixed between rewards, rebased at each reward.
drawdown.fundedApplies: yes (instant)

payout.first: 28-day review cycle in the Terms (marketing mentions monthly, bi-weekly and on-demand options)
payout.cap: none stated
payout.consistency: Plan-specific Inconsistency Score (best day / period P&L); at or above the plan maximum, no Reward.

restrictions.news: News straddling and gap trading around scheduled events or within 2 hours of market close prohibited (payout denial).
restrictions.automation: AI/HFT bots, mass-order entry and latency scalping prohibited.
restrictions.copyTrading: Copy trading across OFP accounts prohibited.
restrictions.holdTime: HFT one-minute pattern listed as prohibited.
restrictions.riskLimits: Floating P&L must not fall below -1% of account size where the plan has a Max Risk Limit: T&C 6.2.1 says the account is closed immediately, the help centre calls it a soft rule with a balance reset. Max 2 active trades in the same direction and asset.
restrictions.other: Rewards are reviewed at the end of each 28-day period; all positions must be closed by 23:59 the day before Review Day.

contradictions: 1% floating-loss rule: hard closure in T&C 6.2.1 vs soft balance reset in the help centre.
Payout timing: 28-day review in the Terms vs bi-weekly/on-demand options in marketing.
